title: Preliminary geologic map emphasizing bedrock formations in Alameda County, California
authors: R. W. Graymer, D. L. Jones and E. E. Brabb
source_crs: EPSG:26710 (NAD27 / UTM 10N), determined from source grid controls
transformation: Inverse of UTM zone 10N + NAD27 to NAD83 (1) + NAD83 to WGS 84 (43) + axis order change (2D)

QTl.name: Livermore gravels
QTl.description: Poorly to moderately consolidated gravel, conglomerate and coarse sand; locally siltstone and claystone.

Tbr.name: Briones Formation
Tbr.description: Marine sandstone, siltstone, conglomerate and shell-rich beds.

Ks.name: Unnamed sandstone and shale
Ks.description: Bedded sandstone, siltstone and shale; sandstone is locally mica-bearing and cross-bedded.

Qu.name: Surficial deposits, undivided
Qu.description: Undifferentiated young surface deposits. This bedrock map does not resolve their detailed sediment types.

Qar.name: Artificial rock fill
Qar.description: Sand, gravel, cobbles and boulders used in dam construction.

Qls.name: Landslide deposits
Qls.description: Selected large landslide deposits. The source intentionally omits most landslides.

H2O.name: Water
H2O.description: Water area in the source map.

Tt.name: Tice Shale
Tt.description: Shale and claystone, locally with siltstone, mudstone and siliceous beds.

To.name: Oursan Sandstone
To.description: Sandstone with siltstone and mudstone or claystone; lithology varies among mapped assemblages.

Tcs.name: Claremont siliceous rocks
Tcs.description: Chert and siliceous shale; described as Claremont Shale or a member of the Claremont Formation.

Tccs.name: Claremont sandstone and siltstone
Tccs.description: Fine-grained quartz sandstone and siltstone within the Claremont unit.

Tss.name: Unnamed sandstone
Tss.description: Poorly consolidated sandstone and siltstone with diatomite, diatomaceous chert and freshwater limestone.

Tlp.name: Unnamed freshwater limestone
Tlp.description: Freshwater limestone; age uncertain in the source description.

Tn.name: Neroly Sandstone
Tn.description: Volcanic-rich sandstone with minor siltstone, shale, tuff and conglomerate.

Tgvt.name: Green Valley and Tassajara formations, undivided
Tgvt.description: Nonmarine sandstone, siltstone and conglomerate, with local tuff beds.

Tsv.name: Silicic volcanic rocks
Tsv.description: Rhyolite and dacite plugs, dikes and sills.

Ku.name: Unnamed sedimentary rocks
Ku.description: Mudstone, siltstone and sandstone; proportions vary among mapped assemblages.

KJfm.name: Franciscan mélange
KJfm.description: A heterogeneous mixture of blocks in a sheared matrix.

sp.name: Serpentinite
sp.description: Sheared serpentinite and serpentinized ultramafic rock, locally altered to silica-carbonate rock.

notes: General geologic context at approximately 1:50,000 source detail. Contacts are not surveyed plot-scale boundaries.
Source mapped in 1996; newer mapping may exist. NGMDB shapefile conversion preserves the original data.
Geology is clipped to a rectangle surrounding both study sites. No simplification or imagery alignment was applied.
Most Quaternary deposits are combined into Qu. Most landslides are omitted.
Fault line type and location certainty are preserved; this layer does not describe present fault activity.
Descriptions summarize the original report and combine variation among assemblages; colors are atlas display colors, not official map symbols.
Mapped rock units do not measure soil depth, weathered-bedrock thickness or water-storage capacity.
